probe_meanings.fitted: actual saved centered annual fitted mean
probe_meanings.frozen: recursive frozen-path mean-response intervention under the current exposure reference
probe_meanings.incoming: embedded preceding frozen mean; retains its preceding exposure reference
probe_meanings.current: centered covariance times current truth score; signed current-reference contribution
probe_meanings.one_step: mean response using the actual saved incoming mean, under the current exposure reference
probe_meanings.actual_minus_frozen: actual fitted mean minus recursive frozen intervention; need not average to zero
probe_meanings.incoming_to_updated: frozen minus raw embedded incoming; includes current-reference recentering
probe_meanings.saved_incoming: actual saved proper-prior mean; retains its preceding exposure reference
probe_meanings.one_step_minus_saved_incoming: one-step mean response minus raw saved incoming; includes current-reference recentering

figure_contracts.representation_information: actual and projected broad/local/rough native truth; shared within-pattern scale; graph/native likelihood precision and null statuses distinct from exposure constraints
figure_contracts.transmission_scale_pressure: five-year saved and frozen-path broad diagnostics; entrant/returner/null controls outer zero; paired fixed-grid objective differences and gaussian regional risk

interpretation_rules: geometric projection establishes representability only; retain omitted actual truth
null components and gaussian variance establish identification or precision costs under the declared design and law
weak frozen transmission establishes conditional suppression, not inappropriate shrinkage
criterion/risk disagreement may motivate pooling/objective alignment, never a selected replacement
signed carry is conditional evidence for particular years, never unconditional temporal risk
incomplete reconciliation or unstable rank stops affected interpretation
limitations: known-truth synthetic results do not identify real players
gaussian likelihood precision and risk do not validate game-pace uncertainty
frozen-path mean-response interventions hold adaptive selected covariance paths fixed; they are not conditional expectations given scales
actual minus frozen-path values need not average to zero and are not an independent error source
global pooling may rationally sacrifice sparse contrasts; oracle risk cannot select deployable scales
reference shares remain conditioned on; additive-rate, volume, positivity, source robustness and chance valuation remain separate
no nomination, admission, handoff or automatic next study follows

resources.bytes_read_scope: consumed fixed manifests and exact spec, including baseline identity hash
